finalText:
Builds clean now — exit 0, 0 errors. The link stage was failing on two real bugs from the bundler bump (fakepack 3.11.2 → 4.2.0), buried under a wall of deprecation-warning noise:

1. **`src/core/options.js`** — the new bundler passes options as `{ retryCount }`, but `resolveRetries` still read `options.retries` (now `undefined`), so `.toFixed(0)` threw. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
2. **`src/net/retryPolicy.js`** — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but `isBackoffEnabled` had no case for `undefined` and threw. Now treats `undefined` as `false` (disabled), matching old loader behavior.

The remaining 8 warnings are just deprecation/lint noise (DEP0142/0198/0233/0250/0267 plus the 3 `W*` warnings) unrelated to build failure — left as-is since they don't block the build.
